Implemented the fix in `tokio/src/fs/file.rs:614`.

`poll_read` now returns `Poll::Ready(Ok(()))` immediately when the destination has no remaining capacity, instead of spawning a background zero-byte read that leaves the file in an EOF-producing state.

Validated:
- `cargo test --test fs_file --features full` — 17 passed
- `cargo test --lib --features full fs::file` — 28 passed
